review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one theorem, `independent_exact_circular_primitive_boundary`, plus six `local instance` declarations that give `TensorFiber`, the dual tangent space and `CovariantTwoTensor p` their normed and continuity structure. It defines no new structure, class or definition. The instances only re-expose existing typeclass structure through `inferInstance` or `inferInstanceAs`. The theorem is stated with Mathlib notions (`ContMDiff`, `ContDiff`, `OpenPartialHomeomorph`, `IsCompact`, `MapsTo`, `tsupport`, `EventuallyEq`), and I saw no competing Mathlib-style concept. I did not open the Mathlib sources, and I did not check whether the local instances repeat instances in other project files. That would be duplication inside the project, not duplication of Mathlib, so it is outside this rubric. The domain-specific pieces (`SmoothMetric`, `MetricGoodPhaseData`, `realBoundaryProfile`, `orderedCrossing` and others) come from imported project files that I did not trace to any Mathlib counterpart. I saw nothing to show they duplicate Mathlib, so I am abstaining.
